data.narrative:
Atmo is a Series A AI & Software company founded by Alex Levy and Johan Mathe that has raised $29.1M to date. Valuation assessment relies on two methods triangulated against a peer universe of 9 comparable companies—1 public (Palantir) and 8 private—including Reflection AI, Together AI, Physical Intelligence, and Black Forest Labs operating in the same sector and stage.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x multiplier to the $29.1M raised as a proxy for current value, implying a $58M valuation. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector comparables at Series A or adjacent Series B stages yields a $7.0B implied valuation, with the peer set spanning $3.2B (Black Forest Labs) to $25.0B (Reflection AI). The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneous outcomes within frontier AI, where stage alone poorly predicts valuation.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $49M (stage-progression floor) to $8.0B (peer-median upper bound), with a median point of $3.5B. The extreme spread reflects structural tension: stage-progression suggests modest step-up from capital deployed, while peer comparables imply substantially higher values. Key uncertainties include differentiation of Atmo's technical capability relative to the peer set, revenue traction or user metrics not available in this dataset, and whether Reflection AI's $25B valuation represents a durable market signal or an outlier. The $3.5B–$8.0B band warrants primary focus pending additional operational data.
